PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Senior Business Analyst and Scrum Master with 12+ years of IT experience, including extensive experience in US 
Healthcare payer applications, claims adjudication, pricing and reimbursement, authorization, billing, and EDI 
transactions. Experienced in requirement analysis, business rule clarification, functional solution definition, 
stakeholder collaboration, UAT support, and end-to-end delivery coordination. Hands-on experience supporting 
Agile delivery through sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint 
tracking, risk and dependency management, impediment resolution, and coordination across Product Owners, 
Business, Development, QA, and offshore teams. Strong understanding of US Healthcare workflows, including 
claims lifecycle, eligibility, prior authorization, Medicare/Medicaid concepts, HIPAA, and EDI 837, 835. Certified 
Scrum Master with proven experience leading cross-functional teams, facilitating client communication, 
supporting release readiness, and driving continuous improvement across healthcare technology projects.
